rubric: registered per-claim supported, contradicted, unsupported, uncertain; assessment evidence IDs must be checked citations for that claim; semantic labels are advisory and host controls final disposition
stop_rule: All fifteen new holdout cases run once in fixed order under all four arms; no early stop, no post-result tuning, and every scheduled failure remains in the denominator. Synthetic screen pass never authorizes adoption.
latency_cost_semantics: Fixture-assigned assessor latency/cost only; both are simulated and capped per case. Local Python elapsed time is separately measured; actual model latency and price are unknown. A timed-out, failed or late call still consumes its assigned simulated resource.
